name: karpathy-guidelines
description: Behavioral guardrails against the six most common LLM coding failure modes: unstated assumptions, overbuilding, changes beyond the ask, no success condition, claiming done without output, and sprawling non-atomic changes. Use when writing, editing, reviewing or refactoring code, when the user says 'keep it simple', 'surgical change', 'don't over-engineer', 'minimal diff' or 'verify before saying done', or when a change keeps growing beyond the ask. For a full code review, see code-review.
